title: TechCrunch Mobility: The Nvidia backup plan for China’s self-driving industry
summary: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.
llm_summary: TechCrunch Mobility explores how Nvidia is positioning itself as a safety net for China’s burgeoning self‑driving sector, offering its powerful AI chips and software platforms to keep Chinese automakers on track despite geopolitical pressures and supply‑chain hiccups. By providing a flexible, locally supported ecosystem, Nvidia aims to help Chinese manufacturers continue developing autonomous vehicles while mitigating the risk of Western tech restrictions.
